notes: A SIGUSR2 handler installed with rt_sigaction (glibc's restorer) copies its 440-byte signal frame (from the ucontext pointer minus 8) and the FPU state it points to just before returning; raise(SIGUSR2) delivers it on return from tgkill, so the trampoline's rt_sigreturn restores rax = 0

context.fpstate.xstate is required exactly when the handler finds FP_XSTATE_MAGIC1 in the frame and reports the extension under that key (the default QEMU CPU model may lack XSAVE, in which case the field must be absent); its size is the frame's xstate_size minus 512
